scopeNote: Website and documentation version log for spheredesci.org. Release numbers track public site updates only and do not represent experimental measurements or results.

releases.title: Organized 4-section navigation, 29 hand-drawn icons & versioned changelog
changes: Reorganized desktop and mobile navigation into four clear sections — Experiment, Library, Governance, and Community — alongside direct Visual Lab and Search links.
Added 29 bespoke hand-drawn scientific-etching SVG icons (/assets/nav-icons.svg) so every section and destination has a distinct emblem rather than text-only links.
Built a full-viewport sectioned mobile navigation drawer with quick Home and SPHEREVL spotlight cards, working natively via HTML details even without JavaScript.
Restructured the homepage into numbered chapters with a sticky horizontal Chapter Wayfinder bar, side-by-side plain-language guide, Explore by section portal, and this versioned release log.

releases.title: Control Room subdomain routing, Worker hardening & homepage diagrams
changes: Routed lab.spheredesci.org directly to the live SPHEREVL Control Room simulator dashboard (educational simulation, not physical measurements).
Refined the homepage hero stage and added two technical schematics: Frequency Response (Null vs. Hypothesis) and Protocol LOC-1 Differential Metrology Architecture.
Hardened Cloudflare Worker analytics and community remix voting endpoints, SVG sanitization, breadcrumb origin validation, and HTML lint checks.

releases.title: Q-factor guide, environment-replay & blind-analysis notes, CodeQL
changes: Published the Q factor (quality factor) explainer under /learn/ covering damping ratio, ring-down time, and measurement methods.
Added research journal notes on environment record-and-replay relocation, blind analysis of LOC-1 position labels, and copper's thermal resonance coefficient.
Aligned Protocol LOC-1 registered status wording across generated pages, enabled CodeQL static analysis, and added IndexNow verification.

releases.title: Mobile video byte-range playback, hreflang SEO & three research posts
changes: Re-encoded the homepage explainer video and added HTTP byte-range support in the Cloudflare Worker for reliable playback on iOS Safari and Android.
Published three research journal articles: Loop-Induced Lorentz Violation, NIST High-Frequency Acoustic Resonators, and Open-Science Funding Infrastructure.
Added self-referencing hreflang="en" and x-default metadata across all indexable pages.

releases.title: Registered Protocol LOC-1, Zenodo whitepaper & MDX publication platform
changes: Linked the live Protocol LOC-1 preregistration on OSF (osf.io/5b6mj) and archived technical whitepaper on Zenodo (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23583932) with permanent footer badges.
Launched the build-time MDX research platform powering /research/, /knowledge/, /glossary/, /search/, RSS feeds, and structured citations.
Recorded SPHERE Research, LLC entity formation across governance pages and expanded /learn/ explainers.

releases.title: Initial public site launch, SPHEREVL showcase & community pages
changes: Launched the plain-language homepage with three-phase funding transparency and the 48-second animated concept explainer.
Added the SPHEREVL visual lab overview (/vl/), twelve foundational /learn/ guides, the hollow copper sphere reference page, and informal community logo votes (/vote/).
Published the directory, calendar, newsletter archive, verified links, research charter, and career-outline pages.
